programme.title: Symphony No. 3, in D minor
programme.desc: The symphony's immense emotional scope, features innovative use of large-scale forces for breathtaking sound, and an ambitious philosophical journey that connects listeners to the grandeur of the natural world.

programme.title: Works by Bach, Bartók, and Brahms
programme.desc: Iván Fischer leads his Budapest Festival Orchestra in a programme consisting of works by J. S. Bach, Béla Bartók and Johannes Brahms; the programme opens with Bach's Brandenburg Concerto No. 3 in G major, BWV 1048.

programme.title: Gershwin's Greatest Hits
programme.desc: Belgian conductor Jos van Immerseel leads Anima Eterna Brugge.

programme.title: Sibelius, Mendelssohn & Saariaho
programme.desc: Stephanie Childress leads the LSO in a Northern European concert from LSO St Luke's, featuring works by Sibelius, Mendelssohn and Kaija Saariaho; the evening includes Sibelius's En Saga and Cassazione, Mendelssohn's Violin Concerto.

programme.title: Franz in Vienna: Mozart and Schoenberg
programme.desc: Austrian conductor Franz Welser-Möst leads the Cleveland Orchestra in a performance of Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart’s Divertimento No. 2 in D major, KV 131, and Arnold Schoenberg’s Variations for Orchestra, Op. 31.

programme.title: Grieg's Piano Concerto & Beethoven Symphony No. 7
programme.desc: Conductor Jan Latham-Koenig leads the Flanders Symphony Orchestra in a concert recorded at Concertgebouw Brugge, Belgium; Felix Mendelssohn's concert overture Die Hebrides, Op. 26; Edvard Grieg's Piano Concerto in A minor, Op. 16.

programme.title: Sinfonía por el Perú from Philharmonie de Paris
Hollywood Gala: Award Night at the Symphony
programme.desc: A musical journey through the sounds of Oscar winners, from classics like "Casablanca" and "Citizen Kane" to monumental cinematic works like "The Godfather"; blockbusters with soundtracks that for almost a century have made us shudder, melt and cry.

programme.title: Schumann - Violin Concerto & Symphony No. 1
programme.desc: Violin Concerto in D minor, WoO 23, featuring Dutch violinist Isabelle van Keulen as the soloist; Symphony No. 1 in B-flat major, Op. 38. The concert recording is from Auditorium du Nouveau Siècle in Lille, France, on June 16, 2017.

programme.title: Richard Strauss - A Hero's Life, Op. 40
Beethoven - Symphony No. 9 in D Minor, Op. 125
programme.desc: Swiss conductor Philippe Jordan and the Orchestre de l'Opéra national de Paris recorded all of Ludwig van Beethoven's symphonies in 2014-2015. In this program, maestro Jordan presents Beethoven's final symphony: Symphony No. 9 in D minor, Op. 125.

programme.title: The Berliner Philharmoniker in Japan
programme.desc: Claudio Abbado's Japanese tour.

programme.title: Mozart -- Quintet for Piano and Winds, K. 452
programme.desc: Luca Vignali (oboe), Angelo De Angelis (clarinet), Carmine Pinto (horn), Eliseo Smordoni (bassoon), and Linda Di Carlo (piano) perform Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart's Quintet for piano and winds in E-flat major, K. 452.

programme.title: Fantasymphony: One Concert to Rule them all
programme.desc: Featuring film music hits from Oscar-winning movies such as "The Lord of the Rings," "Game of Thrones," "The Chronicles of Narnia" and "Harry Potter." Concert orchestration based on the original arrangements and instruments of the film scores.

programme.title: Tchaikovsky - The Nutcracker

programme.desc: Les Dissonances is a collective of artists founded by violinist David Grimal in 2004. In this performance, Les Dissonances perform Pyotr Ilyich Tchaikovsky's Symphony No. 4 in F minor, Op. 36. Recorded at La Cité de la musique in Paris in 2016.

programme.title: Chamber music by Mozart and Shostakovich
programme.desc: French violinist Renaud Capuçon appears at the festival Les Coups de Cœur de Chantilly, presenting a chamber music program consisting of classical and 20th century repertoire. He performs with the soloists of the International Menuhin Music Academy.

programme.title: Franz in Vienna: Mozart and Schoenberg
programme.desc: Austrian conductor Franz Welser-Möst leads the Cleveland Orchestra in a performance of Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart’s Divertimento No. 2 in D major, KV 131, and Arnold Schoenberg’s Variations for Orchestra, Op. 31.

programme.title: Schumann - Violin Concerto & Symphony No. 1
programme.desc: Violin Concerto in D minor, WoO 23, featuring Dutch violinist Isabelle van Keulen as the soloist; Symphony No. 1 in B-flat major, Op. 38. The concert recording is from Auditorium du Nouveau Siècle in Lille, France, on June 16, 2017.

programme.title: Piano Duets -- Mozart, Ravel, Rachmaninoff a. o
programme.desc: Russian pianists Nikolay Lugansky and Vadim Rudenko join forces in a program for two pianos comprising works of Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart, Maurice Ravel, Anton Arensky, Sergei Rachmaninoff and Nikolai Kapustin.

programme.title: Hollywood Gala: Award Night at the Symphony
programme.desc: A musical journey through the sounds of Oscar winners, from classics like "Casablanca" and "Citizen Kane" to monumental cinematic works like "The Godfather"; blockbusters with soundtracks that for almost a century have made us shudder, melt and cry.

programme.title: Hollywood Gala: Award Night at the Symphony
programme.desc: A musical journey through the sounds of Oscar winners, from classics like "Casablanca" and "Citizen Kane" to monumental cinematic works like "The Godfather"; blockbusters with soundtracks that for almost a century have made us shudder, melt and cry.

programme.title: The Four Seasons
programme.desc: Things change for a middle-class couple (Alan Alda, Carol Burnett) and two other couples they vacation with four times a year.

programme.title: Schubert -- Symphony No. 9 in C Major, D 944
Classica Spotlight
programme.desc: Cinematic clips and energizing concert pieces featuring up-and-coming artists.

programme.title: Hollywood Gala
programme.desc: A firework display with music from Hollywood films.

programme.title: Piano works by Rachmaninoff, Beethoven & Glazunov
programme.desc: Nikolay Lugansky presents works by Rachmaninoff as well as Ludwig van Beethoven and Alexander Glazunov.

programme.title: Divas and Diamonds
programme.desc: A performance filled with unforgettable voices and expressiveness.

programme.title: Beethoven - Symphony No. 9 in D Minor, Op. 125
programme.desc: Swiss conductor Philippe Jordan and the Orchestre de l'Opéra national de Paris recorded all of Ludwig van Beethoven's symphonies in 2014-2015. In this program, maestro Jordan presents Beethoven's final symphony: Symphony No. 9 in D minor, Op. 125.

programme.title: A Tango Night: Live from Buenos Aires
programme.desc: The Orquesta Filarmónica del Teatro Colón under Daniel Barenboim performs live at an Argentinean music festival.

programme.title: A Tribute to Vienna
programme.desc: Chamber music ensemble The Philharmonics pays tribute to the music of Vienna from Vienna's Café Sperl; the ensemble consists of musicians from the Vienna Philharmonic and the Berlin Philharmonic.

programme.title: Sibelius, Mendelssohn & Saariaho
programme.desc: Stephanie Childress leads the LSO in a Northern European concert from LSO St Luke's, featuring works by Sibelius, Mendelssohn and Kaija Saariaho; the evening includes Sibelius's En Saga and Cassazione, Mendelssohn's Violin Concerto.

programme.title: Galaxmphony - The Final Odyssey
programme.desc: The DR Symphony Orchestra breaks the sound barrier and takes you out into the galaxies - to a place between reality and fantasy with soundtracks from Star Wars, The Mandalorian, Star Trek, Dune and many more.

programme.title: Bach: Goldberg Variations BWV 988
programme.desc: Chinese pianist Zhu Xiao-Mei performs J. S. Bach's "Goldberg Variations BWV 988" at the Leipzig Bach Festival.

programme.title: Works by Bach, Bartók, and Brahms
programme.desc: Iván Fischer leads his Budapest Festival Orchestra in a programme consisting of works by J. S. Bach, Béla Bartók and Johannes Brahms; the programme opens with Bach's Brandenburg Concerto No. 3 in G major, BWV 1048.

programme.title: Solheim Cup 2021 Highlights
programme.desc: Highlights from the third day of the biennial Solheim Cup in Toledo, Ohio. Here, the singles matches took place to conclude the famous tournament.

programme.title: Solheim Cup 2023 Highlights
programme.desc: Highlights from the second day of the 2023 Solheim Cup. With 28 matches played over three days in Spain, see who gained the upper hand in the foursomes and fourballs.

programme.title: Solheim Cup 2023 Highlights
programme.desc: On the last day of the Solheim Cup, singles matches begin with the score finely poised at 8-8. Will Europe complete the comeback or will the USA win for the first time in six years? (24.09)

programme.title: Solheim Cup 2024 Highlights
programme.desc: On the final day of the Solheim Cup, Robert Trent Jones Golf Club is set for a thrilling finale. Team Europe look to mount a comeback as they trail USA 10-6 ahead of the singles. (15.09)

programme.title: Women in Golf: Breaking Tradition
programme.desc: ...Tradition. In this documentary, meet the pioneers who are shaping the future of golf as the sport that is often defined by history and tradition moves away from its male-dominated roots.

programme.title: Europe! Europe!
programme.desc: The inside story behind Europe's back-to-back success on home soil in the Solheim and Ryder Cups from the players and captains at the heart of the action.

programme.title: The Greatest Solheim
programme.desc: Take a look back at a dramatic 2019 Solheim Cup from the famous Gleneagles in Scotland, featuring interviews from the key players involved in the drama that saw Europe win back the trophy.

programme.title: Live Solheim Cup Opening Ceremony
programme.desc: On the eve of the 2026 Solheim Cup, Bernardus Golf stages an opening ceremony for women's golf's biggest team event - taking place in the Netherlands for the first time.

programme.title: Hall or Nothing: Georgia's Story
programme.desc: In 2018, Georgia Hall became the first home champion of the Women's British Open in nine years - her very first Tour win. This documentary presents her remarkable journey in the sport.

programme.title: ATP Final: Mallorca
programme.desc: A maiden ATP Tour crown is on the line as home hope Alejandro Davidovich Fokina, 0-5 in finals, meets Ethan Quinn as the two collide in a title showdown on the grass of Mallorca. (27.06)

programme.title: Boxing: O. Jones v E. Carranza
programme.desc: Headlining a stacked card featuring four world title fights, the IBF super-welterweight champion Oshae Jones rematches Elia Carranza after last year's split-decision victory. (13.06)

programme.title: WTA Final: Auckland
programme.desc: Elina Svitolina competes in her second Auckland final and the 24th of her career overall as the Ukrainian plays seventh seed Xinyu Wang, who features in just her second WTA final. (11.01)

programme.title: EFL Cup Retro: Chelsea v Spurs
programme.desc: A chance to relive a classic encounter as Chelsea and Tottenham Hotspur meet at Wembley in the final of the 2014-15 League Cup. The sides last met at this stage in the 2007-08 final.

programme.title: Best of the NFL 25/26
programme.desc: The Detroit Lions open their 2025 season on the road against NFC North rivals Green Bay Packers, who completed the blockbuster trade of Micah Parsons from the Dallas Cowboys. (07.09)

programme.title: Carnage from the hardest race on Earth

programme.title: El primer descenso de la la montaña K2 con esquís
programme.desc: El esquiador polaco Andrzej Bargiel se convierte en el primero en descender la montaña K2 con esquís, completando una hazaña histórica desde los 8,611 metros de altura.

programme.title: La leyenda del rally con ocho títulos mundiales
programme.desc: Sébastien Ogier se despide del rally ganando su octavo y último título mundial, cerrando una carrera legendaria con una temporada final llena de maestría y determinación.

programme.title: The King of Tekken: Arslan Ash – historia de GAMING
programme.desc: Descubre cómo Arslan Ash se convirtió en el mejor jugador de Tekken del mundo y en toda una leyenda.

programme.title: Vuelo de 245 k/h a través de un túnel de Estambul
programme.desc: El piloto italiano de acrobacia aérea Dario Costa atraviesa los túneles Çatalca en Estambul, Turquía, en solo 40 segundos a una velocidad de 250 km/h.

programme.title: Nazaré: Making Giants – Lucas Chumbo & Kai Lenny│SURF
programme.desc: Lucas Chumbo y Kai Lenny redefinen el surf de olas grandes en Nazaré, Portugal, al superar los límites de lo posible, enfrentando riesgos y celebrando la evolución de este deporte extremo.

programme.title: Nazaré: Making Giants – La experiencia de los surfers
programme.desc: Nazaré es el hogar de la nueva generación de surfistas de olas grandes, donde la espera del oleaje se vive con tensión y expectativa junto a los pioneros que empujan los límites del deporte.

programme.title: Nazaré: Making Giants – la nueva generación de surfers
programme.desc: Conoce a la próxima generación de surfistas de grandes olas que intentan encontrar su lugar en Nazaré, en la costa de Portugal.

programme.title: Nazaré: Making Giants – Competencia de olas grandes
programme.desc: Llega el Nazaré Big Wave Challenge, donde los mejores surfistas de olas grandes del mundo se enfrentan a olas imponentes para cerrar la temporada.

programme.title: Nazaré: Making Giants - las olas más grandes del mundo
programme.desc: Descubre el pequeño pueblo pesquero de Nazaré en Portugal que alberga las olas más grandes del mundo.

programme.title: Red Bull Soapbox Race: máquinas caseras en Tokio
programme.desc: Equipos construyen sus propios coches sin motor para desafiar una pista empinada llena de obstáculos en Tokio, Japón, donde la competencia se basa en velocidad y creatividad de diseño.

programme.title: Red Bull Soapbox Race San Marino: descenso sin motor
programme.desc: Equipos compiten en Red Bull Soapbox Race San Marino con coches caseros sin motor, enfrentándose a una pista llena de obstáculos donde la velocidad, la creatividad y el diseño son clave.

programme.title: Red Bull Soapbox Race: velocidad y obstáculos en Chile
programme.desc: Equipos construyen sus propios coches sin motor para desafiar una pista empinada llena de obstáculos en Santiago de Chile, donde la competencia se basa en velocidad y creatividad de diseño.
